suggestions: I'm grateful for the peaceful quiet right after Subuh to center my intentions before the workday begins.
I'm thankful for finally tracking down and resolving that tricky bug that had been haunting our staging branch all week.
I'm grateful for a warm, frothy cup of teh tarik and a quick break from the monitor screen.

I'm grateful for a completely seamless production deployment with zero rollbacks or unexpected downtime.
I'm thankful for the soothing sound of afternoon rain while in the middle of a deep-focus coding session.
I'm grateful for teammates who give constructive, encouraging pull request reviews without any ego.
I'm thankful for a spontaneous late-night mamak catch-up with close friends to decompress from the week.
I'm grateful for the energy and curiosity to keep learning new frameworks and leveling up my skills.
I'm thankful for a warm, home-cooked meal waiting for me after a long day of back-to-back sprint meetings.

I'm thankful for senior developers and mentors who patiently take the time to explain complex system architecture.
I'm grateful for a successful sprint demo and the sense of accomplishment seeing our feature go live.
I'm thankful for the barakah in small daily wins, like green unit tests and an uncluttered inbox.
I'm grateful for my parents' constant doa and support as I navigate my career and personal growth.
